doc: THE STD GUARD, further above it: slope 14 gives a pre-normalization std of 1.8e-10, still about 180 times the guard: the output has std 1 (a guard of 1e-9 or more would shrink it to 0.18 or less). Same setting as the slope 10 case with a steeper spectrum. The white noise the seed draws is the input plan0.white (size, size). FFT convention: numpy fft2 unnormalized forward, ifft2 divides by size^2, k = fftfreq(size) * size. Measured: max |diff| 1.8e-15 (6.4e-13 relative above 1e-3; scipy.fft 1.8e-15): 1e-9 relative / 1e-10 absolute.
